# 🎮 v0.1.0 - Your VALORANT menu, your way

Hey everyone, s1moscs here.

I got tired of VALORANT's menu, so I made my own. **ValoShell swaps the client's menus for one you pick: fourteen styles, a studio to rearrange every page, and everything the client does, from queueing with your party to equipping skins.**

This is the first public release, the one from the video. Let's go through it.

---

## Fourteen menu styles

Every style is a whole menu, not a colour swap: its own navigation, panels, fonts and layout.

- **VALORANT, now and then:** the current client, VALORANT Glass, the Beta menu and VALORANT 2022.
- **Other games' menus, playing VALORANT:** the League client, CS2, CS:GO, CS 1.6, Fortnite, Minecraft and Halo 3.
- **And three of its own:** Modern, Pip-Boy and Terminal.

Switch between them any time from the brush button at the top right.

## Everything the client does

- **Play:** queues, party invites and codes, kicks, ready checks and custom games.
- **Agent select:** your team's picks and the timer. Pick and lock in from the menu, and agents you haven't unlocked show as locked.
- **Agents:** every agent's abilities and your Agent Mastery level, with **Show owned agents only**.
- **Lobby:** rank, peak rank, RR, win rate and party stacks for every player.
- **Post-match:** the full scoreboard, your stats and your RR change.
- **Store:** daily offers, bundles, accessories and the Night Market.
- **Collection:** every skin, chroma and level, equipped straight from the menu.
- **Career:** rank, act history and match history.
- **Social:** friends with their status and mode, and the latest VALORANT news.

> [!NOTE]
> **Enemy ranks during agent select are off by default**, and ValoShell never asks for them unless you switch them on.

## Studio

- **Drag, resize and restyle every piece of every page.** Colours, fonts, corners, grain and backdrop are yours to change.
- **Layouts save in one click**, so you can keep a few and swap between them.
- **Widgets** (stream delay, clock, match score) fit any size, with four looks (Panel, Glass, Minimal, Broadcast) and four layouts (Auto, Row, Stack, Compact).

## Made for streaming

- **Streamer mode** hides every name on screen.
- **An in-game overlay** that stays click-through.
- **The [InstantClone](https://github.com/Soulhackzlol/InstantClone) widget** sets your stream delay or cuts back to live without leaving the menu.

## How it works

ValoShell talks to the **Riot Client already running on your PC**, through the same local API the official client uses. It covers the menus, steps aside when your match starts and comes back when it ends.

- **Nothing to log in to.** Your session comes from the Riot Client.
- **Nothing touches the game.** No injection, no memory reading, no input automation.
- **No unfair extras.** No instalock, and streamer mode only ever hides names.

> [!WARNING]
> ValoShell isn't endorsed by Riot. It only does what the official client can, but it's a third-party tool, so use it at your own discretion.

---

## Getting started

1. Download `ValoShell-v0.1.0.exe` below.
2. Start VALORANT's Riot Client.
3. Open ValoShell.

> [!TIP]
> **"Windows protected your PC"?** The build isn't code-signed, so SmartScreen warns about it. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. If nothing opens at all, install Microsoft's [WebView2 Runtime](https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/) (Windows 11 already has it).

---

It's a first release, so you will find rough edges. Tell me on [GitHub](https://github.com/Soulhackzlol/ValoShell/issues/new/choose): most of what gets fixed starts as someone telling me something is annoying.

---

> ValoShell is open source and the build isn't code-signed, so Windows Defender may show a false positive on first download OR even block it.
> You can verify the file against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, scan it on VirusTotal, or build it yourself.
